### 1. Scene
This appears to be a portion of tomato-and-cheese pasta bake, accompanied by cooked leafy greens and broccoli. The main dish is somewhat difficult to identify from the photo.

### 2. Vessel
A round dinner plate, approximately **26 cm** in diameter.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3. Items
- Pasta bake with visible tomato sauce and melted cheese
- Broccoli florets and stems
- Cooked leafy greens, likely spinach
- A few roasted vegetable pieces near the upper edge
- A light oil sheen on the vegetables

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Area shares below describe separate portions of the visible food footprint; sauce and cheese are included in the bake.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|

| Broccoli | 12% | 64 cm² × 1.8 cm = 115 ml | 0.55 g/ml | 63 g | 35 | 22 kcal |
| Cooked leafy greens | 10% | 53 cm² × 1.2 cm = 64 ml | 0.45 g/ml | 29 g | 25 | 7 kcal |

The food footprints total **62% of the plate**, consistent with the substantial exposed rim and lower section. The cooked greens use a higher density than loose raw leaves because they are wilted and compact.

### 8. Sanity check
Approximately **372 g and 477 kcal** is plausible for this moderately sized portion. The biggest uncertainty is the composition and thickness of the main bake; a reasonable overall energy range is **350–650 kcal**.
